requirements.quote: `getCalendarRange` returns per-day counts and entries (listing, confirmed next date, obligation due, vacation or holiday marker from the forum calendar when present) for a range up to 42 days in one query set.
Week view shows days as rows grouped by hall on desktop and an agenda list on phone; month view shows a density grid with per-day counts and clash and deadline markers.

Selecting a day opens a popover with the day's listings and deadlines; 'Open day' navigates to the Court-Day Board for that date (`today`/`tomorrow` aliases when applicable, otherwise `calendar?day=`).
Entries are visually and textually distinguished by kind (listing, next date, obligation due, holiday) using icon, label and tone, never colour alone, with a legend.
Entries are provenance-aware: unconfirmed next dates appear as 'Proposed' with a dashed style and are excluded from counts of confirmed commitments.
Scope toggle Mine / Whole chamber follows `court_day:view_all`; clerk sees dates and counts without strategy fields.
'Subscribe in your calendar' shows the private ICS feed URL from #53 when it exists, with a regenerate action owned there, and a clear explanation that it is private to the user.
Empty (no entries in range), loading skeleton, error with retry, offline (cached range from #65 when available, else notice) and permission-denied states are implemented.
Keyboard: arrow keys move across days, `Enter` opens the day, `t` jumps to today, `w`/`m` switch view, `[`/`]` previous and next range; a11y grid semantics are correct.
p95 < 300 ms for a month range on the seeded chamber dataset; route JS <= 180 KB gzip.
requirements.evidence: measured by the CI e2e perf and bundle-size jobs (e2e/lighthouserc*.json, ship PR CI); the in-lane part is a single-query-set read with the existing due_date index
